description: This Java source code defines an abstract class 'EntityIdWithType' which serves as a base implementation for entity IDs that are aware of their entity type within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for equality checks, compatibility validation, and string representation, and manages an internal wrapped EntityId. The class is designed to be immutable and is annotated accordingly.

classes.name: EntityIdWithType
classes.description: Abstract class implementing entity IDs that are aware of their entity type, providing methods for equality, compatibility checks, and object representation.

methods.name: createEqualityValidator
methods.description: Creates a consumer that validates equality of entity IDs against an expected ID, deprecated in favor of 'isCompatibleOrThrow'.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if a given entity ID is compatible with this ID, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getIllegalArgumentExceptionForDifferentEntityIds
methods.description: Constructs an IllegalArgumentException indicating mismatched entity IDs.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Returns whether the internal entity ID is a dummy.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare entity ID and entity type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on entity ID and type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the entity ID.
